note: Published ClinePass reference rates. ClinePass is a flat monthly subscription, so these are the underlying rates the subscription quota is measured against. They drift from what billing actually charges, which is why they are only a fallback: primary rates are fitted from this account's own usage rows, and these values fill in models whose fit is not estimable and the cache-write class, which usage rows do not report separately.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: Peak values are listed. Off-peak rates are lower, and usage data reports peak and off-peak spending as one blended figure, so a measured rate for this model is an aggregate.

qwen3.7-plus.note: <=256K token tier. The >256K tier is 1.20 / 4.80 / 0.12 / 1.50 and is not modelled here.

free_models.note: Free promotions are catalog-declared at $0. Cline documents free-model usage as unavailable through the Cline API, so the zero price cannot be confirmed from billing and it can change without notice.
